title: Reflection as Data
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting reflection as data to the reflection codebook with coded excerpts and decision-linkage trace, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the reflection codebook with coded excerpts and decision-linkage trace shows a defensible decision in AIL 606.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next.
